description: Full cluster board: the tokens with ACTIVE tracked-wallet cluster events right now, ranked by consensus score. Candidates come from DexScreener's public attention feeds (boosts + latest profiles, Solana) plus registered narrative canonicals; each candidate is cluster-scanned live and only tokens with real tracked-wallet activity make the board. Per token: consensus score, signal, tracked buyers/sellers, tracked net USD, safety band, canonical status. An empty board is a real answer — it means no cluster events were detected in the current candidate set, not an error. This is the in-loop product: poll it to catch convergence as it forms. Cost: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 — no API key.
name: cluster_feed
